subject: Re: Request to net duplicated tokens and proposed one-time credit
messages:
From: Olivia Hayes <olivia.hayes@trucommerce.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts_payable@trucommerce.com
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected usage increase on July invoice — possible double-counting

Hi Kimberly,

We pulled July's invoice and saw a ~42% jump in billed tokens vs our internal telemetry for the same window. We run periodic replays of our ingest pipeline and suspect some short-lived prefixes were reprocessed during a retention backfill on 2027-07-20 which may have led to duplicate token attribution.

Can you help:
- Confirm whether Redwood saw an ingestion retry or replay for our tenant uuid tc-9a4f on 2027-07-20 to 2027-07-21.
- If duplicates are confirmed, what's the process to net those tokens or issue a credit?

I'm attaching a small sample (first 200 rows) from our telemetry that highlights two request_id groups that look like duplicates. Happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Thanks,
Olivia Hayes
Head of Platform Operations
TruCommerce
Attachment: trucommerce_usage_sample.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hayes <olivia.hayes@trucommerce.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected usage increase on July invoice — possible double-counting

Hi Olivia — thanks for the sample and the heads up. We will investigate on our side.

Quick note on process: if we confirm double-counting caused by a platform-side reingest/replay, Finance can issue a one-time credit (credit memo) that nets against the July invoice. To get there we'll need:
- a minimal evidence package from both sides (your sample + our ingest audit slice)
- a short calculation showing duplicated token count and the resulting monetary offset

Ben/Monica: can one of you pull the ingest audit slice and a token attribution export for tenant tc-9a4f for 2027-07-19 through 2027-07-22? If you need my go-ahead on the credit calculation once done, say so and I'll approve it.

Olivia — we'll aim to have the audit excerpt and a proposed credit by EOD Wed (2027-08-04).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: ingest audit excerpt + preliminary token diff (internal)

Kim / Monica / Rishi — attaching the audit slice I pulled from the ingest pipeline: the job logs show three specific replay batches processed for tenant tc-9a4f on 2027-07-20 between 02:14 and 02:55 UTC (log ids: job-7341, job-7342, job-7346). We've cross-referenced those IDs with session IDs in the usage export and found ~1,875,420 tokens that appear in both the 'primary' attribution and the 'replay' attribution across the window.

Notes:
- We applied the same tokenizer and sequence-length bucketing used for billing to ensure apples-to-apples comparison.
- The sample Olivia shared matches the event hashes in the audit for 82 of the 200 rows — good confirmatory signal.

I ran a quick $ calculation using TC's committed rate: 1,875,420 tokens * $0.00668/token = $12,520.14. That's our preliminary one-time credit amount if we net the duplicated tokens. I put the detailed math in the attached workbook.

Attachments: ingest_audit_excerpt.txt (15KB), credit_calculation_breakdown.xlsx (sheet: summary)

Ben Carter
Billing Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Hayes <olivia.hayes@trucommerce.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts_payable@trucommerce.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ingest audit excerpt + preliminary token diff (internal)

Hi Ben / Kimberly,

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for the workbook — that math aligns with our expectations. The event hashes you flagged are the same duplicates our replay job created during a backfill. We appreciate the verification.

Two quick asks from our side before we can sign-off:
1) Can Redwood issue a draft credit memo we can route to our AP team (accounts_payable@trucommerce.com) so they have the reference for reconciliation?
2) Please confirm the credit will be applied as a netting adjustment against the July invoice (do not re-bill future months).

If both are fine, AP will process the memo and we can close this.

Olivia

>

>
> K.
